title: Ship bee-how and bee-why, and answer Trace and Provenance questions in the reply
action: Create two thin user-facing shortcut skills and make their route clean (per D1). Do NOT run bee dev regen (wave-barrier). BEE-HOW and BEE-WHY: follow the bee-writing-skills checklist and the frontmatter shape of skills/bee-teach/SKILL.md (name equal to directory, folded description, metadata version '0.1', ecosystem bee, bee-cli dependency mapping with missing_effect degraded). Each skill is a door, never a copy: it scopes the question, invokes bee-researching, loads `bee-researching/references/trace-and-provenance.md`, and runs "Trace" (bee-how) or "Provenance sweep" (bee-why). It never restates, shortens or reorders a step of either procedure. Body sections, short: a one-paragraph door statement; Run (read-only, no brief file, the account is the reply); Scope the question (a vague target gets its reading as the first line and the skill never stops to ask; the other half of a how-and-why ask becomes the one next action as a ready /bee-why or /bee-how question; an outside library goes to bee-researching; bee-why pins the path:line range, the symbols and the search terms, sweeps every row because the user asked for reasons, treats a guess inside the question as one hypothesis, and asks for the constraint set when the user means to change the code); Reply (first line: the answer in one sentence, bee-why adds its tier; then the procedure's answer shape with tier words and empty or unswept rows kept as written; close on exactly one next action; at a gate the gate wins per `bee-hive/references/routing-and-contracts.md` ("Communication contract")); Headless; Handoff 'Account delivered. Invoke bee-hive skill.' Descriptions must separate the three explain skills: bee-how 'Use when the user types /bee-how or asks how a command, hook, flow or subsystem of this repo runs or where its parts live. Not for why it is built this way (bee-why), a paced explanation to understand a topic (bee-teach), an outside library (bee-researching), or changing code.' bee-why 'Use when the user types /bee-why or asks for the recorded reason, with evidence, behind a rule, value, guard or design of this repo, or what a change must keep. Not for how the code runs (bee-how), a paced explanation to understand a topic (bee-teach), locking or superseding a decision (bee-shaping), or an outside library (bee-researching).' Cite every qualified pointer without the skills/ prefix: pointer_integrity resolves qualified pointers under skills/. BEE-RESEARCHING/SKILL.md: in § Output add one line: A Trace or Provenance question skips the four-step order and answers in the reply; no brief file unless the user asks to keep one. In § Recommendation ladder add: at the start, state what answer would settle the question; close it as settled, refuted or inconclusive, and an inconclusive result travels as an open question, never as a yes. BEE-TEACH/SKILL.md: sharpen the description so a request for the recorded reason with evidence routes to bee-why and teach keeps 'help me understand' (a paced plain account); in the Reply line add: when a thread is worth chasing, the one next action is a ready /bee-how <question> or /bee-why <question>. README.md: in the 'Craft skills' table under the hive-role table, add one row each for `bee-how` and `bee-why`, one sentence each. CREATION-LOG.md for bee-how and bee-why from the template, with the named deviation from psh-1, and RED H1 to H4 recorded verbatim from shortcut-red-results.md (all PASS on behavior, contaminated by the repo's always-loaded rules, so the skill body stays minimal); note that H4 is proven by a text diff, not a GREEN run; leave GREEN and Final Outcome as 'pending, recorded by cell pca-10'.
